paragraphs: Yosef HaBavli, Zevachim 17b, is Yosef of Hutzal; see Isi ben Akiva. Rav transmitted in his name: Arvei Pesachim 113b, end. Yoma 52a: Rabbi Yochanan said, ‘Yosef of Hutzal asked.’ A tanna of the baraita. Tosefta, Parah, chapter 3: Yosef HaBavli.
